title: Yellow Roasted Brazilian Chicken Skewers
description: A roasted Brazilian dish featuring chicken skewers marinated in white wine and ferment jang, perfect for a hangover cure. This springy dish is full of flavor and easy to make.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together white wine, ferment jang, olive oil, garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the chicken to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the chicken in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until cooked through.
Serve the chicken hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before serving.
